description: Válvula Sistema Acueducto. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Pieza de equipo que se ubica en una tubería u orificio, en la cual el elemento de cierre es rotado o desplazado transversal o longitudinalmente al flujo de agua, con el fin de controlar el flujo o detener el paso del agua, permitiendo aislar áreas de operación u otras piezas de equipo. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá ESP - EAAB. Its tags are Bogotá D.C., Contraflujo, Control, EAAB, Flujo. It offers 1 resource(s) in ESRI REST. The portal shows 2022-10-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
